definitions.explanation: A large, elegant wading bird with long legs and neck. Cranes are symbols of longevity and good fortune in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {鶴|つる}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丹頂鶴|たんちょうづる}→丹頂鶴：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: You can see red-crowned cranes in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: ⟦{千羽鶴|せんばづる}→千羽鶴：30425_senbazuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{折|お}って→折る：01263_oru⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I folded a thousand paper cranes and gave them to my sick friend.

notes:
{鶴|つる} refers to cranes, particularly associated with the red-crowned crane (⟦{丹頂鶴|たんちょうづる}→丹頂鶴：noentry⟧).

Common expressions:
- ⟦{千羽鶴|せんばづる}→千羽鶴：30425_senbazuru⟧ (thousand paper cranes - folded for wishes/recovery)
- ⟦{折|お}り{鶴|づる}→折り鶴：12782_orizuru⟧ (origami crane)
- {鶴|つる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一声|ひとこえ}→一声：08921_hitokoe⟧ (the voice of authority; a decisive word from the top)
- {鶴|つる}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{千年|せんねん}→千年：noentry⟧、⟦{亀|かめ}→亀：02198_kame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{万年|まんねん}→万年：28146_mannen⟧ (cranes live 1,000 years, turtles 10,000 years - wishes for longevity)

Counter: ⟦{羽|わ}→羽：01007_wa⟧

Cultural note:
The ⟦{丹頂鶴|たんちょうづる}→丹頂鶴：noentry⟧ (red-crowned crane) is a national symbol of Japan and appears on the logo of Japan Airlines. ⟦{千羽鶴|せんばづる}→千羽鶴：30425_senbazuru⟧ became internationally known through the story of Sadako Sasaki, who folded paper cranes while hospitalized after the Hiroshima bombing. Cranes symbolize longevity, good fortune, and fidelity.
